dedupe_keys.name: nca ghana monthly industry data voice and mobile data subscriptions and regional quality of service monitoring reports

description: Ghana's National Communications Authority publishes subscription statistics and quality of service monitoring results. The mobile data page offers yearly files of mobile data subscriptions from 2017 to June 2026, with monthly industry data by operator in the latest file, and historical voice and data subscription figures from 1996 to June 2016. The reports page holds statistical bulletins, research reports and quality of service monitoring reports, including half-yearly monitoring from 2016, regional reports on the quality of data services for the Ashanti, Brong Ahafo, Central, Eastern and Northern regions in 2016, and drive test results for the first quarter of 2020. The authority also publishes consumer complaints reports. Coverage: Ghana, national and by operator, with regional quality measurements. Format and access: PDF files and some Word documents, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: PDF only; regional quality reports are dated (2016 and 2020); the June 2026 file was not opened, so its breakdown is inferred from its title. Simulation uses: subscription trends by operator and measured regional service quality for Ghanaian mobile service models. Related records: the ITU ICT statistics give comparable national series; the Ookla open data performance tiles give crowdsourced speeds for Ghana.
licence: not stated (only a site copyright notice on the provider pages read on 2026-09-28)
